raggadeath.bio: Toronto group Raggadeath was a Canadian rap-metal and reggae-rock project whose mid-1990s recordings fused heavy guitars with dancehall rhythms and featured vocalists including Michie Mee.

realestk.bio: Scarborough-born singer-songwriter RealestK, born Rony Kordab, is a Canadian R&B artist known for melancholic, trap-inflected vocals and the breakout single WFM.

red-1 of rascalz.bio: Vancouver MC Red-1 is a veteran of Canadian hip-hop and a founding member of the Rascalz, the influential West Coast group behind the landmark all-star single Northern Touch.

rel mccoy.bio: Toronto-born emcee, producer, singer, songwriter, engineer and DJ Rel McCoy, formerly Relic the Oddity, is a Canadian independent hip-hop artist now based in Spain.

rhye.bio: Rhye is the alternative-R&B project led by Toronto-born Canadian singer and producer Mike Milosh, known for intimate vocals, minimal arrangements and atmospheric soul.

ricky j.bio: Montréal DJ, rapper and songwriter Ricky J is a Canadian recording artist known for early-2000s pop-rap hits including No Means No and later the gold-certified Whatta Night.

rochester.bio: Toronto rapper Rochester is a Canadian hip-hop artist and lyricist whose catalogue includes collaborations with producers such as Boi-1da and longtime work across the city's independent scene.

roney.bio: Toronto rapper Roney, born Tyrone Smith, is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose gritty street rap, melodic flows and long-running Don't Sleep mixtape series built a large local following.

rufus wainwright.bio: Montréal-raised Canadian-American singer-songwriter and composer Rufus Wainwright is known for ornate art-pop, piano-driven songwriting, theatrical performances and work in opera and classical composition.

sage harris.bio: Toronto-born singer, songwriter and dancer Sage Harris is a Canadian R&B artist whose performance-driven work combines contemporary soul, pop and choreography.

sebastien grainger.bio: Mississauga-born musician, singer, songwriter and producer Sebastien Grainger is a Canadian artist best known as the vocalist and drummer of dance-punk duo Death From Above 1979.

see spot run.bio: Montréal-formed, Toronto-based band See Spot Run is a Canadian rock group known for independent radio success, extensive national touring and the hit single Weightless.

shades of culture.bio: Montréal trio Shades of Culture is a pioneering Canadian hip-hop group whose English-language rap and turntablism helped establish Québec hip-hop beyond the province in the 1990s.

shaye.bio: Shaye was a Canadian pop and folk-rock group formed by established singer-songwriters Kim Stockwood, Damhnait Doyle and Tara MacLean, with a catalogue built around close harmonies and melodic songwriting.

shi wisdom.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Shi Wisdom is a Canadian neo-soul and R&B vocalist known for expressive, classically informed singing and songwriting credits for artists including Rita Ora.

simone denny.bio: Toronto-born vocalist Simone Denny is a Canadian dance and house singer best known as the voice of Love Inc., BKS and Widelife and for enduring club hits including You're a Superstar and Broken Bones.

sleepy tom.bio: Squamish-born DJ and producer Sleepy Tom, born Cam Tatham, is a Canadian electronic artist known for energetic house production and the platinum-certified Diplo collaboration Be Right There.

spek.bio: Montréal rapper Spek, born Hussain Yoosuf, is a Canadian hip-hop artist and former member of Dream Warriors whose career later expanded into music publishing and entrepreneurship.

soul attorneys.bio: Québec City group Soul Attorneys is a Canadian pop and R&B band whose late-1990s catalogue produced several Canadian top-10 singles and touring work with Céline Dion.
